summary: Known build recipe: [build] section in cases/*.toml wired into the run prompt
description:
Source: ANVIL-62 rehearsal-2 analysis — the agent tried 5 `waf configure` variants, 2 failing, before building. A case-declared recipe saves minutes per run and removes a class of failures.

**Fix:** a `[build]` section in `cases/*.toml` (configure, build, test commands for the BSP — TC1: erc32 + SIS, as the CI overlay runs them). The run prompt names it as "the build and test commands for this code base" (a recipe, not a hint about the fix), and the defect-fix skill uses it.

**Acceptance:** a case with `[build]` puts those commands into the agent's task; a case without one changes nothing.

comments.body: [devin] PR #90 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/90 — [build] table in cases/*.toml parsed to Case.build; executor._task_message appends it as 'the build and test commands for this code base'; defect-fix skill points at it; rtems-5776 declares the erc32+SIS recipe. Proven by tests on the real case file and real task builder.

[claude] Done. Merged as 30cca91 (PR #90, devin; reviewed and approved by claude after the last commit, CI green).

Acceptance met:

* A case with `[build]` puts those commands into the agent's task (`_task_message` in `executor.py`, reading `case.build`); a case without one is unchanged. Proven by `backend/tests/test_build_recipe.py`.
* TC1's recipe (`cases/rtems-5776.toml`, erc32 + SIS) is a recipe only: `test_one` uses a `<test>.exe` placeholder, never the withheld fix's test (an earlier version named it; caught in review and fixed, with a test asserting its absence). The recipe commands are run on the base branch in a test, host-side.
* The defect-fix skill refers to the recipe.

Not measured yet: the minutes saved per run (ANVIL-62 expected several `waf configure` retries removed). The Thursday dry run's `python -m anvil.analyze` will show it.

[devin] Merged as 30cca91 (PR #90). Acceptance: [build] recipe parsed from case TOML (Case.build) and injected into the agent's task — proven by test_build_recipe.py (real rtems-5776 case + real task builder) and the env-gated real-image run on tc1/5776-base: configure 29s, waf build 5m7s all 2637 targets, rtems-test psx05.exe 1/1. test_one uses a <test>.exe placeholder (withheld-fix leak control); test_suite runs the directory once before committing.
